title: Measure a string using TempleOS routines
prompt:
Store the exact ASCII string TEMPLEOS TEMPLEOS in TempleOS.
Use HolyC string routines or a loop to measure its length and count its
uppercase E characters. Print two separate lines:
BENCH_LENGTH=<decimal length>
BENCH_E_COUNT=<decimal count>
Leave both output lines visible and finish. Measure the stored string in
TempleOS rather than inserting constants for the answers.
